{"type":"flowgraph","mermaid":"graph TD Q["Lab forms I still have to fill out"] --> A["Variant A: stored requirements
start from MaterialIntakeRequirement rows"] Q --> B["Variant B: implied by configuration
start from MaterialIntake rows"] A --> A1["keep a row when its intake is
in one of my queues (Exists)"] A1 --> A2["drop it when a Complete LabForm exists
for the same intake and form type
(NotExists, TenantOnly)"] A2 --> RA["count rows: CountMode Rows,
a listable work list"] B --> B1["pair each intake in my queues with the forms
its material type requires (TuplePivot)"] B1 --> B2["drop a pair when a Complete LabForm exists
for it (NotExists, TenantOnly)"] B2 --> RB["count distinct pairs: CountMode KeyDistinct,
read-only buckets"] ","style":"notebook"}
